lessons.title: Excessive compression is not automatically beneficial

lessons.title: Glyph token cost is a property of the vocabulary, not of the representation
lessons.measured_by: HML V3 representation search, pinned GPT-2 byte-level BPE
lessons.note: FM-004's escaping penalty reproduces under a second, independent vocabulary, so the UTF-8 hard gate is not an artifact of one tokenizer. The absolute token counts do not reproduce: every glyph the corpus needs is one token under Qwen3-8B and two or three under GPT-2. Any absolute token ranking is a statement about a vocabulary.
lessons.requirement: report token counts alongside bytes and tokenizer-free pre-tokens, and name the vocabulary in every token claim

lessons.title: Identifier-corruption detection saturates across every candidate
lessons.measured_by: HML V3 representation search, generation-zero seeds, 24 real V2 transitions
lessons.note: An altered identifier either fails to resolve or resolves to a different declaration, so every representation over an identity-carrying canonical state detects it. The axis was removed from Pareto selection before the search began and detect_drop_field took its place. detect_truncate_tail reads 0.000 for fifteen of sixteen seeds because the trailing block is usually the structured delta, which is outside the declared semantic contract; the one exception drops the delta entirely, which makes its tail contract content.
lessons.requirement: an instrument whose arms all saturate is reported as non-discriminative and excluded from selection, never reported as agreement

lessons.title: Goal linearization is unmeasurable on a corpus of single-goal states
lessons.measured_by: HML V3 representation search, pilot run, 317-transition V2 corpus
lessons.note: This is FM-014's problem in a new place and now quantified per axis. The V2 corpus is structurally rich in local context (mean 13.4 declarations, 63.4 intra-context references) so context_order moves the measurement 90% of the time, but it averages 1.01 goals per state, so every goal-linearization strategy renders identically. A ranking over graph_serialization from this corpus would be selection on noise.
lessons.requirement: report the share of single-axis mutations that changed the measurement, per axis, beside any claim about that axis; an axis at 0% is reported as unmeasurable on this corpus rather than as tied
